title: **Tighten word by word, then hide every cut.**
text: Inside every kept passage cut out the pauses, restarts and doubled words, fillers and tag questions, the host's calls to the crew and his asides about the show; hide each cut with a J/L copy, a short cover from the same moment or the broadcast's own camera change. Seen in the user's D1 of 20261126: 176 such cuts took out 360 s (median sound clip 1.9 s, the agent's v1 21.9 s), and only 21 of 226 sound cuts were in-sync jumps.
